description: Check an IBAN’s country length, available national format rules and Mod-97 checksum on the EuroKYB server. Returns valid and reason. This checks the identifier only. Account ownership and existence require confirmation from the bank.

iban.description: IBAN with its country prefix. Spaces and lowercase are accepted, e.g. GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32.

name: verify_iban
